---
title: Smarter starting level: "Can you do 5?" check per ladder
labels: ui,enhancement
---

## Problem
Setup only asks New / Some / Strong, which sets all ladders at once. Someone can be strong at squats and weak at pull-ups.

## Fix
- Optional step after setup (and in Exercises → each ladder): show the step picture and ask "Can you do 5 clean reps of this?" Yes → move up one step and ask again; No → stay. 3–4 taps per ladder.
- Only for the main strength ladders (Push, Pull, Row, Squat, Hinge, Core, Dip).
- Never change a ladder the person has already logged.

## Done when
- [ ] Each strength ladder can be calibrated in ≤ 4 taps
- [ ] Skippable; skipping keeps the current behaviour
